properties.description: Platinum Sulfur Nitride on Carbon catalyst
Initial and after 3000 CVs polyoxometalate-modified carbon with SH groups
Platinum on Sulfur and Nitrogen co-doped Carbon catalyst
Platinum supported on OMC-NH2 or NH4

nodes.name: SH tethering to SBA-15
nodes.procedure: -SH groups were tethered onto SBA-15 by refluxing modifier, (3-Mercaptopropyl) trimethoxysilane, in the SBA-15 suspension
nodes.source_text: The synthesis procedure of Pt-SBA-15_SH and Pt/OMC_SH is illustrated in Figure 1. -SH groups were tethered onto SBA-15 by refluxing modifier, (3-Mercaptopropyl) trimethoxysilane, in the SBA-15 suspension, which were denoted as SBA-15_SH

nodes.name: Pt4+ anchoring on SBA-15_SH
nodes.procedure: SBA-15_SH template was dispersed in H2PtCl6 solution and stirred for 12 h at room temperature to anchor Pt4+ ions onto them (Pt-SBA-15_SH)
nodes.source_text: Thereafter, SBA-15_SH template was dispersed in H₂PtCl₆ solution and stirred for 12 h at room temperature to anchor Pt⁴⁺ ions onto them (Pt-SBA-15_SH)

nodes.name: PDA coating and carbonization
nodes.procedure: Then, the carbon support precursor, PDA, was combined with the Pt-SBA-15_SH by immersing the Pt-SBA-15_SH in the dopamine hydrochloride solution. The obtained sample was heated at 900°C in Ar/H2 atmosphere for 2 h to reduce Pt4+ ions to metallic Pt NPs as well as carbonize PDA. In this process, Pt and S components that were originally resided on SBA-15 template, were transferred onto the carbon support through a process resembling reverse-printing method.

nodes.name: SBA-15 template removal
nodes.procedure: Finally, the SBA-15 template was removed with HF, yielding the Pt/OMC_SH catalyst
nodes.source_text: Finally, the SBA-15 template was removed with HF, yielding the Pt/OMC_SH catalyst

nodes.name: NH2 tethering to SBA-15
nodes.procedure: (3-aminopropyl) trimethoxysilane to modify SBA-15 as template (SBA-15_NH2) in a similar preparation process to that of Pt/OMC_SH
nodes.source_text: Pt/OMC_NH2 was also synthesized by using (3-aminopropyl) trimethoxysilane to modify SBA-15 as template (SBA-15_NH2) in a similar preparation process to that of Pt/OMC_SH

nodes.name: Pt4+ anchoring on SBA-15_NH2

nodes.source_text: in a similar preparation process to that of Pt/OMC_SH

nodes.characterization_summary: Pt/OMC_SH shows ultrafine Pt NPs with average size 2.4-2.6 nm homogeneously dispersed on OMC_SH matrix; Pt/OMC_NH2 shows Pt NPs generally <5.5 nm; Pt/OMC_OH shows no Pt NPs detected.
nodes.evidence_snippet: the particle size statistics show that finer Pt NPs with the average particle size of 2.4–2.6 nm are homogeneously dispersed on the OMC_SH matrix (Figure 2e,f) ... In the case of the Pt/OMC_OH no Pt NPs can be detected on the OMC, as revealed by TEM images at different magnifications (Figure 3a,b)

nodes.characterization_summary: Pt/OMC_NH2 HRTEM shows lattice spacing of 0.23 nm indexed to Pt (111) plane by FFT; Pt/OMC_SH shows similar Pt crystallinity with associated FFT patterns.
nodes.evidence_snippet: In the HRTEM image (the inset of Figure 3d), the lattice spacing within the dots is determined to be 0.23 nm by Fast Fourier Transform (FFT), which can be indexed to the (111) lattice plane of Pt ... f) high-resolution TEM image of Pt/OMC_SH (the-inset is the associated FFT patterns)

nodes.characterization_summary: Pt/OMC_SH and Pt/OMC_NH2 show Pt diffraction peaks at ≈39.7°, 46.2°, and 67.4° assigned to (111), (200), and (220) planes; Pt/OMC_OH shows no Pt peaks.
nodes.evidence_snippet: In contrast, the diffraction peaks at ≈39.7, ≈46.2, and ≈67.4° can be observed in the XRD patterns of Pt/OMC_SH and Pt/OMC_NH2 samples, which are assigned to (111), (200), and (220) planes of Pt.

nodes.characterization_summary: Pt/OMC_SH has higher I_D/I_G value (0.845) indicating high degree of defects due to S-atom doping.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Pt/OMC_SH has a higher I_D/I_G value (0.845) than others, meaning a high degree of defects and disorders due to the large-sized S-atom doping.

nodes.characterization_summary: Pt/OMC_SH high-resolution S 2p shows peaks at ≈163.3, 164.6, 167.6 eV corresponding to C-S-C and sulfate species confirming S incorporation; Pt 4f BE shifts lower vs Pt/OMC_NH2 indicating stronger Pt-OMC_SH electron interaction.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The high-resolution S 2p spectrum of Pt/OMC_SH exhibits three peaks at ≈163.3, 164.6, and 167.6 eV, corresponding to S 2p_{3/2}, S 2p_{1/2}, of C-S-C and the sulfate species ... the Pt 4f BE of the Pt/OMC_SH shifts to a lower value in comparison to that of Pt/OMC_NH2

nodes.characterization_summary: Pt contents: Pt/OMC_OH = 0 wt%, Pt/OMC_SH = 8.3 wt%, Pt/OMC_NH2 = 9.5 wt%.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The Pt contents in Pt/OMC_OH, Pt/OMC_SH, and Pt/OMC_NH2 are determined to be 0, 8.3, and 9.5 wt% respectively.

nodes.characterization_summary: Pt/OMC_SH shows highest double layer capacitance C_dl = 119.1 mF cm^{-2} indicating largest effective specific surface area of 2977.5 cm².
nodes.evidence_snippet: Pt/OMC_SH has the highest C_dl value of 119.1 mF cm^{-2} (Figure 5e; Figure S10, Supporting Information), indicating that Pt/OMC_SH has a larger effective specific area (2977.5 cm^2) than the other samples.

nodes.characterization_summary: Pt/OMC_SH exhibits largest ECSA of 78.8 m² g_Pt^{-1} based on hydrogen desorption areas.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Pt/OMC_SH also exhibits the largest ECSA among all the samples (78.8 m² g_Pt^{-1}).

nodes.characterization_summary: Pt/OMC_SH exhibits smallest charge transfer resistance R_ct of 0.87 Ω.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Pt/OMC_SH exhibits the smallest charge transfer resistance (R_ct) of 0.87 Ω.

nodes.characterization_summary: Pt/OMC_SH element mappings show uniform distribution of C, Pt, S, N, and O confirming S transfer from SBA-15_SH to carbon support.
nodes.evidence_snippet: the element mappings are firstly provided in Figure S5 (Supporting Information), which show that C, Pt, S, N, and O are uniformly distributed in Pt/OMC_SH. The presence of S element suggests that the S element has been transferred from SBA-15_SH to carbon materials
